"""
Interface definitions for database modules.

This module provides abstract base classes to decouple business logic
(plugins, utils) from concrete database implementations.
"""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple
from info import DATABASE_NAME


class IMediaRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for media/file repository operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media) -> Tuple[bool, int]:
        """Save a file record. Returns (success, code)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(
        self,
        query: str,
        file_type: Optional[str] = None,
        max_results: int = 10,
        offset: int = 0,
        filter: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], int, int]:
        """Get search results. Returns (list, next_offset, total)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, file_id: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get details for a specific file."""
        pass


class IUsersChatsRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for user and chat repository operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int]]:
        """Get banned users and disabled chats. Returns (user_ids, chat_ids)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get chat settings/status."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, chat_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get settings for a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, chat_id: int, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update settings for a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self) -> int:
        """Get total user count."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self):
        """Get all users cursor."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self) -> int:
        """Get total chat count."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self):
        """Get all chats cursor."""
        pass


class IConnectionsRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for user-group connection operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_connection(self, group_id: int, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Add a connection between user and group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Get currently active group for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[List[int]]:
        """Get all group connections for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if a group is active for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Set a group as active for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_inactive(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Make all connections inactive for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_connection(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Delete a specific group connection for user."""
        pass


class IFiltersRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for group-specific filter operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_filter(self, grp_id: int, text: str, reply_text: str, btn: str, file: str, alert: str) -> None:
        """Add a filter to a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id: int, name: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
        """Find a filter by name. Returns (reply_text, btn, alert, fileid)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id: int) -> List[str]:
        """Get all filter names in a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, group_id: int, text: str) -> None:
        """Delete a specific filter."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id: int) -> int:
        """Count filters in a group."""
        pass
